sections.note:
NOTE: SFU students accepted in the accelerated master’s within the Department of Political Science may apply a maximum of 10 graduate course units, taken while completing the bachelor’s degree, towards the upper division electives of the bachelor’s program and the requirements of the master’s degree.
For more information go to: https://www.sfu.ca/gradstudies/apply/programs/accelerated-masters.html .
